summary: Tested P0 issues for GHG platform: 1) Formula Parameters dropdown fix and 2) Unit Management conversion_to_base removal. All 5 features verified. Fixed 1 minor bug (example text math).

formula_parameters_dropdown.details: Unit conversion section uses Select dropdowns (data-testid='from-unit-select' and 'to-unit-select') instead of text inputs. Dropdown options populated from centralized units API: kg (Kilogram), g (Gram), t (Tonne), L (Litre), mL (Millilitre), kL (Kilolitre), m³ (Cubic Metre), cm3 (cubic centimetre)

conversion_display_math.details: Example text was incorrect: '1 L × 0.85 = 1 kg' - Fixed to correct math: '1 L × 0.85 = 0.85 kg'. The actual conversion display in saved parameters was already correct (showing multiplier value as result).

unit_management_no_conversion_to_base_in.details: Unit list displays: name, symbol, unit_type, aliases, is_base_unit indicator. NO conversion_to_base field shown.
Add/Edit Unit form only has: Display Name, Symbol, Unit Type, Base unit checkbox, Aliases, Description. NO conversion_to_base input field.

api_units_no_conversion_to_base.details: GET /api/units response contains: id, name, symbol, unit_type, aliases, is_base_unit, description, is_active, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at. NO conversion_to_base field in response.

critical_code_review_comments: Good: UnitCreate model (server.py lines 316-323) correctly excludes conversion_to_base
Good: UnitResponse model (server.py lines 325-338) correctly excludes conversion_to_base
